play ... --frame judge-scratch/layout.png --size 800x480 wrote a PNG; header reads 800 x 480 RGBA; also night, paused, title, settings, ledger, summary frames.
Fresh run: texts [Night Market, Layout, Ledger, Settings, Quit], menu_index 0; 0:up stays 0, downs go 1,2,3 and stop at 3, up back to 2.

Settings: Volume: 5 -> right x6 stops at 10, left 9; difficulty Normal -> left Easy, left stays Easy, right Normal, Hard, right stays Hard; texts 'Volume: N', 'Difficulty: Normal'; escape (and Enter on Back) -> title.
Run 1 set volume 9 (folder s1); run 2 same folder started with volume 9, set hard; run 3 started 9/hard; a new folder started 5/normal.
Fresh place, 0:enter -> layout, cursor (0,0), piece stove, slot 1, stock 3/4/2, grid [], texts Layout, Piece: Stove, Slot: 1, Stove: 3, Table: 4, Lamp: 2 + Enter/Escape lines.
left/down at (0,0) stay; up x5 -> y 4 (stops); right x8 -> x 7; down x5 -> y 0; left x8 -> x 0; menu_index 0 and screen layout throughout.
next_piece x3: table, lamp, stove; prev_piece x3: lamp, table, stove; 'Piece:' text followed each.
place stove at (0,0) -> stove 2; again on same cell unchanged; 4th stove at (3,0) with stock 0 unchanged; 5th table and 3rd lamp refused, grid/stock unchanged.
erase on empty (0,4) unchanged; erase lamp at (1,4) -> lamp stock 0->1, grid entry gone, text 'Lamp: 1'; erase again unchanged.
escape at cursor (1,4) -> title; enter -> layout with same grid, cursor (0,0); next run on same folder shows same grid at tick 1.
next_slot 2,3,1; save_slot copied grid into slot 1, grid unchanged; load_slot on empty slot 2 unchanged; erase+save to slot 2; load slot 1 restored grid with stove stock 1->0.
Later run on same folder: slots 1 and 2 as saved, slot 3 empty; next_slot + load_slot gave slot 2's grid (stove stock 1).
Enter with empty grid and with stove only: screen layout + 'Needs a stove and a table' (cleared by next word); with stove+table: night, clock 0, speed slow, coins/served/lost 0, grid same, '18:00'.

Night from tick 6: clock 1 at tick 29, 2 at 53 (24 ticks); fast every 6 ticks; fast at tick 60 kept partial (clock 3 at 65); stop 71-100 clock stood at 3, screen night, 'Speed: Stop'; slow at 101 -> clock 4 at once (progress 23+1).
Seed 1: [5,12,18,...,350,356], all gaps 4..10, <360; same list in separate runs and at tick 19 and 2000 of a night; seed 2 [5,9,13,...], seed 6 [5,14,20,...].
Customers 1,2,3 seated at (1,0),(1,2),(2,1) (lowest x then y); queued with x,y null; one stove/one table: at minute 33 queue 2,3,4 full, customer 5 never appears and lost 1 at minute 34 print.
Stove (0,0) next to table (1,0): customer 1 cooking at minute 5, eating at 25; stove (0,0) with table (2,0): cooking at 34, eating at 35.
No lamp: coins 8, served 1 at minute 35, table taken by next; lamp at (1,1) next to table (1,0): coins 12 at minute 35.

Hard, stove not next to table: customer 1 leaves at 35 (lost +1, coins 0) and customer 2 seated and cooking same minute. Full-night results match my own reference sim for Easy 124/12/38, Normal 40/4/47, Hard 20/2/49.
At minute 35 customer 1 pays, customer 2 from the queue is at (1,0) and cooking in the same minute (both lamp and non-lamp runs).
At 360: screen summary, texts Night over, Coins: 40, Served: 4, Lost: 47, Enter: title = state, clock 360; equals independent reference (customers left in stall not counted lost); Enter -> title.
Same grid/seed/normal: fast, slow, and mixed (fast/stop/slow/fast/slow/stop/fast) all ended coins 40, served 4, lost 47.

Escape -> paused, texts Paused/Resume/Title, clock stood at 15 for 50 ticks; escape resumed and clock went on from same progress; Enter on Resume resumed; Title -> title, ledger [], replay_ready false.
After night: ledger [{40,4,47,normal}], Ledger screen 'Coins 40, served 4, lost 47, Normal'; later run on same folder same; fresh folder 'No nights yet'.
After nights 40/47, 40/47, 20/42(normal), 124/38(easy), 20/49(hard): ledger = Hard, Easy, 20/42 Normal (newest first, 3 kept); replays and a given-up night added nothing.
After a finished night, later run: title [Night Market, Layout, Replay, Ledger, Settings, Quit], replay_ready true.
Seed 7, difficulty hard, stove erased: Replay -> night, replaying true, 'Replay' text, original grid and seed-1 arrivals; summary 'Replay over' 40/4/47; ledger unchanged; second replay later same.
After loading a slot without the (0,0) stove, adding a lamp, seed 3, hard: Replay still had original 6-piece grid and arrivals and ended 40/4/47.
Two copies of the same kept folder, seed 5, same 1000-tick script: outputs byte-identical (cmp); seeds 2 and 6 gave different arrivals.

layout.png: 8x5 grid, red stoves at (1,0),(2,0), brown tables at x 3, yellow lamp disc at (2,4), white cursor box at (2,3); panel shows Piece: Table, Slot: 2, Stove: 1, Table: 0, Lamp: 1, all matching state.

night.png at 18:45: grid pieces, 2 grey queued discs at left, blue seated at (4,4),(0,1), orange cooking at (3,3), green eating at (1,0) as in state; panel Coins: 12, Served: 1, Lost: 0, 18:45, Speed: Fast.
title.png '> Ledger', settings.png '> Difficulty: Hard', ledger.png 3 lines and '> Back', paused.png '> Title', summary.png Night over / Coins / Served / Lost / Enter: title.
README gives keys and script words, the play commands for state and frame (worked with the harness in their place), and says everything is kept in the --settings folder.

defects: A headless run of --ticks 0 prints every key as null (screen null, not title): the state is only written on the first tick.
While paused, speed reports the night's speed (e.g. fast) rather than a value tied to the pause; harmless but not stated in the README.
In the title and ledger frames, long lines ('Night Market', ledger lines) run past the right edge of the text panel.
The random stream is not reseeded per night, so a second night in the same run gets different arrivals than a first night with the same seed (documented in README).
